name: WisdomTree Government Money Market Digital Fund
collateral: U.S. government obligations, cash, and repurchase agreements held by WisdomTree Digital Government Money Market Fund; '40 Act-registered money market fund administered by WisdomTree Asset Management and recorded natively on-chain via the WisdomTree Connect platform
pegMechanism: $1.00 stable NAV money market share; SEC-approved 24/7 dealer trading at fixed $1 intraday (Feb 2026); primary subscription and redemption are gated to WisdomTree Connect users with USDC dealer settlement and USD-wire alternatives

proofOfReserves.provider: WisdomTree Asset Management (daily NAV and holdings published on fund page)

jurisdiction.license: Investment Company Act of 1940 (registered money market fund)

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: WisdomTree acts as transfer agent for WTGXX with permissioned token transfers restricted to WisdomTree Connect-onboarded holders, giving the issuer freeze and burn authority over WTGXX balances.

yieldConfig.yieldSource: WisdomTree WTGXX U.S. government money market fund

notices.title: Multi-chain fund with limited on-chain telemetry
notices.message: WTGXX is the digital share token of WisdomTree's '40 Act government money market fund, also deployed on Arbitrum, Avalanche, Base, Optimism, Plume, and Stellar via WisdomTree Connect. Pharos currently tracks only the Ethereum supply contract pending per-chain verification; live reserves use a curated weekly snapshot of the WisdomTree fund factsheet.
